sources.snippet: OpenAI GPT2 Overview OpenAI GPT-2 model was proposed in Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners by Alec Radford, Jeffrey Wu, Rewon Child, David Luan, Dario Amodei and Ilya Sutskever from OpenAI. It's a causal (unidirectional) transformer pretrained using language modeling on a very large corpus of ~40 GB of text data.
